description: Fixed Broadband Deployment Data: June 2020 Status V2 is a dataset listed in Federal Communications Commission open data portal (opendata.fcc.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a national body, published or maintained by Federal Communications Commission. The data collected to create this dataset was in place through data as of June, 2021. Coverage: United States. The portal files it under the category Wireline. Its tags are broadband, wcb, fcc, 2020. The table has 15 columns. The portal shows 2021-11-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-fcc-gov-portal.
